name: Zambia
leaders: President Hakainde Hichilema (UPND), re-elected on 13 August 2026 and sworn in for a second term on 1 September 2026; Vice-President Mutale Nalumango
leadersIs: Hakainde Hichilema forseti (UPND), endurkjörinn 13. ágúst 2026 og settur í embætti til annars kjörtímabils 1. september 2026; Mutale Nalumango varaforseti
summary: Hakainde Hichilema was re-elected in the first round on 13 August 2026 with 60.49% of valid votes against 37.87% for Brian Mundubile of the Tonse Alliance, and his UPND won a majority in the enlarged National Assembly. Mundubile rejected the result and was detained on treason charges, which he denies, and no election petition was filed within the legal deadline; the next general election is due in 2031.
summaryIs: Hakainde Hichilema var endurkjörinn í fyrri umferð 13. ágúst 2026 með 60,49% gildra atkvæða gegn 37,87% hjá Brian Mundubile úr Tonse Alliance, og flokkur hans UPND fékk meirihluta á stækkuðu þjóðþingi. Mundubile hafnaði úrslitunum og var handtekinn, ákærður fyrir landráð sem hann neitar, og engin kæra vegna kosninganna var lögð fram innan lögboðins frests; næstu almennu kosningar eiga að fara fram árið 2031.

chamber.name: National Assembly
chamber.asOf: as elected on 13 August 2026 (224 of 226 constituencies declared, 40 proportional seats, up to 14 appointed or ex officio members); others include 20 independents, Resolute Party 5 and Zambia Must Prosper 1
chamber.asOfIs: eins og kjörið var 13. ágúst 2026 (úrslit í 224 af 226 kjördæmum, 40 hlutfallssæti, allt að 14 skipaðir þingmenn eða sjálfkjörnir); aðrir eru m.a. 20 óháðir þingmenn, Resolute Party 5 og Zambia Must Prosper 1

lastElection.outcome: Hakainde Hichilema (UPND) was re-elected with 2,965,326 votes (60.49%) against 1,856,222 (37.87%) for Brian Mundubile, as declared by the Electoral Commission of Zambia on 18 August, on a turnout of 57.23%; the UPND won 160 seats in the National Assembly.
lastElection.outcomeIs: Hakainde Hichilema (UPND) var endurkjörinn með 2.965.326 atkvæðum (60,49%) en Brian Mundubile fékk 1.856.222 (37,87%) samkvæmt kjörstjórn Sambíu 18. ágúst og kjörsókn var 57,23%; UPND fékk 160 þingsæti á þjóðþinginu.
